description: This file defines HTTP handlers for Kubernetes API server resource discovery, including version and group discovery handlers, with thread-safe management of discovery data.

classes.name: versionDiscoveryHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler for API version discovery, managing a map of group-version to handlers with thread safety.

classes.name: groupDiscoveryHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler for API group discovery, managing a map of group names to handlers with thread safety.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests for version or group discovery based on URL path.

methods.name: getDiscovery
methods.description: Retrieves the discovery handler for a specific group or version with read lock.

methods.name: setDiscovery
methods.description: Sets the discovery handler for a specific group or version with write lock.

methods.name: unsetDiscovery
methods.description: Removes the discovery handler for a specific group or version with write lock.
